title: customer.negotiate_offer
description: Contract for the customer agent tool `negotiate_offer`. Tools are deterministic Python or store reads; no LLM inside. A live, ad-hoc concession for a sku with no approved play targeting this customer -- distinct from apply_offer, which only redeems an already planner-drafted, holdout-measured play.

reason.description: Human-readable: why a concession is refused, or 'eligible' when ok is true.

min_qty.description: Present only for mechanic 'volume_discount': the quantity that must be ordered together for the discount to apply.
